content: The two earliest manuscript copies of the K. al-Mafāḥiṣ (MS Majlis 10196 f. 119a; Beinecke MS Landberg 146 f. 179b) carry a colophon saying that Sharaf al-Dīn checked the copy and was present in teaching sessions on the work.
refers_to_primary: Ibn Turka, K. al-Mafāḥiṣ, MS Majlis 10196 f. 119a
